```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Root locator: knitr renders with cwd set to the vignettes directory, so
# the package root is found by walking up to the source tree that carries
# the fixture generators and the committed evidence.
.pkg_root <- function() {
  for (dd in c(".", "..", "../..")) {
    if (file.exists(file.path(dd, "DESCRIPTION")) &&
        file.exists(file.path(dd, "R", "treatment-report.R")) &&
        dir.exists(file.path(dd, "tests", "testthat"))) return(normalizePath(dd))
  }
  NA_character_
}
PKG <- .pkg_root()
# Dual-load idiom shared with the bench/scenarios drivers: the source tree
# (check and site-build contexts) loads through pkgload; a bare installed
# package (reader-side) loads through library().
if (!is.na(PKG) && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  suppressWarnings(suppressMessages(pkgload::load_all(PKG, quiet = TRUE,
                                                      export_all = TRUE)))
} else {
  library(msuiter)
}
# load_all does not process the NAMESPACE S3method directives (see
# bench/scenarios/run_treatment.R); register the report methods locally so
# dispatch behaves identically in both load paths.
for (m in c("print.MsTreatmentReport", "as.data.frame.MsTreatmentReport",
            "print.MsHrdReport", "as.data.frame.MsHrdReport")) {
  if (exists(m, envir = asNamespace("msuiter"), inherits = FALSE)) {
    assign(m, get(m, envir = asNamespace("msuiter")), envir = globalenv())
  }
}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

msuiter's paper pillar 3 is the application-scenario layer: end-to-end
workflows that adjudicate against planted truth or an independent oracle and
persist their evidence tables. The three executable drivers live under
`bench/scenarios/` (`run_atlas.R`, `run_hrd.R`, `run_treatment.R`; committed
evidence under `bench/scenarios/out/`, each driver ends in its own
OVERALL PASS or OVERALL FAIL verdict line). This page runs one reduced,
runnable snippet of each against the same committed fixture generators the
drivers use, and cross-checks the live output against the committed evidence
table whenever that table is on disk.

## Atlas mode: the full cohort adjudication

The atlas scenario plants a synthetic cohort — five variant classes, known
channel plan, known arm differential — then drives the public faces and
adjudicates against the a-priori generator truth. The snippet reproduces the
ingestion-and-tally core; the committed driver adds the class roster,
extraction, hungarian fidelity and association legs with their verdict lines.
The cohort generator below is the very one the driver and the governance
tests share (`tests/testthat/helper-atlas.R`), so the numbers are the same
bytes, not a lookalike.

```{r atlas, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the fixture generators are not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-tally.R"))
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-atlas.R"))
  fx <- .atlas_cohort(dir = file.path(tempdir(), "tour-atlas"))
  truth <- fx$truth
  mv <- ms_variants(fx$variants, genome = "synth", caller = "atlas-synth",
                    matched_normal = "none")
  cat1 <- ms_tally(mv, genome = fx$twobit, mode = "SBS96")
  cat("samples:", ncol(cat1@counts), " channels:", nrow(cat1@counts),
      " planted:", paste(.ATLAS_PLANTED, collapse = ","), "\n")
  cat("SBS96 plan exactness:",
      identical(rowSums(cat1@counts)[truth$sbs_labels],
                colSums(truth$sbs_plan)), "\n")
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "counts_sbs.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, row.names = 1L, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ": maxabs delta =",
        max(abs(as.matrix(cat1@counts) - as.matrix(as.matrix(ref)))), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("committed evidence table not on disk (check tarball): the driver output lives in the repository under bench/scenarios/out/\n")
  }
}
```

The committed tables for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/counts_sbs.csv`, `counts_dbs.csv`, `qc_report.csv`,
`compare_sweep.csv`, `pbr.csv`, `prevalence.csv`, `association.csv`.

## Byte-exact HRD: adjudication against the dual oracles

The HRD leg reproduces Cortes-Castro's published values (PMID 31151873)
pLOH-by-segment-integration and the aneuploidy count, and every adjudicated
row must be *byte-identical* to the independent oracle implementation carried
in `tests/testthat/helper-hrd.R`. The planted geometry encodes the composite
claim: only the double-positive sample (pLOH-high **and** aneuploid) scores
HRD.

```{r hrd, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the oracle fixtures are not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-hrd.R"))
  chr_size <- .HRD_TEST_CHR_SIZE
  arms <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
    function(ch) data.frame(chrom = c(ch, ch), location = c("p", "q"),
      arm_start = c(1L, chr_size %/% 2L + 1L),
      arm_end = c(chr_size %/% 2L, chr_size), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)))
  whole <- function(sample, chrom, state, minor)
    .make_hrd_segments(sample, chrom, start = 1L, end = chr_size,
                       state = state, minor_cn = minor)
  segs <- do.call(rbind, c(
    lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
           function(ch) whole("H1", ch, 5L, 0L)),
    lapply(c("chr1", "chr2", "chr13", "chr17", "chr22"),
           function(ch) whole("H3", ch, 3L, 1L)),
    list(.make_hrd_segments("H2", "chr1", start = 1L, end = 450000L,
                            state = 2L, minor_cn = 0L),
         whole("H4", "chr1", 2L, 1L))))
  report <- ms_hrd_report(segs, genome = "GRCh37", caller = "ascat",
                          assay = "wgs", chr_size = chr_size,
                          arms = arms, ploidy = 2)
  rows <- as.data.frame(report)
  rows <- rows[order(rows$sample), , drop = FALSE]
  print(rows[c("sample", "ploh_fraction", "aneuploidy_count",
               "hrd_score", "evidence_tier")])
  oracle_ok <- TRUE
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(rows))) {
    sub <- segs[segs$sample == rows$sample[i], , drop = FALSE]
    oracle_ok <- oracle_ok &&
      identical(rows$ploh_fraction[i], .hrd_ref_ploh(sub, chr_size)) &&
      identical(rows$aneuploidy_count[i],
                .hrd_ref_aneuploidy_count(sub, arms, 2, rm_black_arms = FALSE))
  }
  cat("dual-oracle byte-exactness:", oracle_ok, "\n")
  stopifnot(isTRUE(oracle_ok))
  stopifnot(identical(rows$hrd_score[rows$sample == "H1"], 1L) &&
            all(rows$hrd_score[rows$sample != "H1"] == 0L))
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "hrd_report.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ":",
        identical(as.integer(ref$hrd_score), rows$hrd_score) &&
        identical(as.character(ref$sample), rows$sample), "\n")
  }
}
```

A missing arm table degrades to attestation, never fabrication: the
`coverage_note` ledger names the missing input and `aneuploidy_count`
stays at zero rather than being invented. The committed table for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/hrd_report.csv`.

## Treatment forensics: association plus clonal timing

No mainstream signature tool offers a treatment-history reporting module.
msuiter's face fits the governed therapy classes (temozolomide, platinum,
thiopurine) against the officially recognised signature identities served
from the sealed bundled COSMIC v3.6 reference, adjudicates each cell by a
bootstrap contrast clearing an effect-size floor, and splits the exposed
mean into clonal/subclonal timing shares. The snippet runs the complete
face on the committed synthetic cohort; the degradation faces (no treatment
records, no clonality) return honest empty tables plus an attestation
ledger, never invented rows.

```{r treatment, message = FALSE}
if (is.na(PKG)) {
  cat("rendered outside the package root: the cohort generator is not reachable here\n")
} else {
  source(file.path(PKG, "tests", "testthat", "helper-treatment.R"))
  fx <- .ms_trt_cohort()
  sigs <- sort(unique(unlist(.MS_TRT_MAP, use.names = FALSE)))
  clon <- expand.grid(sample = fx$samples, signature = sigs)
  clon <- clon[c("sample", "signature")]
  clon$clonal_fraction <- 0.5
  rep1 <- ms_treatment_report(fx$catalog, fx$treatments, clonality = clon,
                              n_boot = 200, seed = 7)
  print(rep1)
  tab <- as.data.frame(rep1)
  cat("association rows:", nrow(tab), " adjudicated associated:",
      sum(tab$is_associated), "\n")
  prov <- attr(rep1, "provenance")
  cat("provenance: refdb", prov$refdb_version, "build", prov$build,
      "method", prov$method, "n_boot", prov$n_boot, "seed", prov$seed, "\n")
  truth_ok <- all(tab$is_associated == vapply(seq_len(nrow(tab)), function(i)
    fx$planted_truth(tab$treatment[i], tab$signature[i]), logical(1)))
  cat("planted-fidelity adjudication:", truth_ok, "\n")
  stopifnot(isTRUE(truth_ok))
  ev <- file.path(PKG, "bench", "scenarios", "out", "treatment_association.csv")
  if (file.exists(ev)) {
    ref <- read.csv(ev, check.names = FALSE)
    cat("live run vs committed evidence", ev, ":",
        nrow(ref) == nrow(tab) &&
        identical(as.logical(ref$is_associated), as.logical(tab$is_associated)),
        "\n")
  }
}
```

The committed tables for this leg:
`bench/scenarios/out/treatment_association.csv`,
`treatment_timing.csv`. The recognition anchors and the adjudication-floor
rationale are documented at the face's manual page
(`?ms_treatment_report`) and in the Phase-8 design memo under
`docs/devlog/`.

## Reproducing the full verdicts

Each driver prints its own adjudication lines and exits zero only on
OVERALL PASS:

```{sh verdicts, eval = FALSE}
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_atlas.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_hrd.R
Rscript bench/scenarios/run_treatment.R
```
